8.t: There are 3 switch selectable options on the bowling board. The seven position switch used to select these is located at location 14A on the main logic board (See Figure D Item 8), and is accessible from the front of the game.
The first two switches select the time that the robot takes to automatically roll the ball. Note that the setting of this switch sets the overall time of the game.
‘Switches three and four control the coinage necessary to operate the game. Coinage sw3 sw
2 players — 1 coin off oft 1 player — 1 coin
1 player ~ 2 coins on on 2 players — 4 coins
Note: The third setting is intended primarily for the overseas market.
‘Switch 5 is used to enable the optional beer frame. The beer frame is enabled when switch 5 is off.
‘Switches 6 & 7 are not used at this time.
